system.description:
Whether it's guns, a bow and arrow, or something else, you know your aim is true.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to the @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry} power. If you already have @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}, either skip it or swap the die with one of your new dice.

Assign one or more of the remaining dice to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.KziYDpbuojnthfT5]{Swinging}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Information qualities category

• Select from Mental qualities category

• Select from Physical qualities category

Abilities

Gain two of the following Green abilities, one using @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry} and the other using one of your qualities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.148AbHjRtdl3Rha6]{Dual Wielder}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.tT4vu7o697Op2yDV]{Load}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.AluvtGwJSkdf4XLW]{Precise Shot}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.dvbFMv65zHv4frfM]{Sniper Aim}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.xDtbK6AiPjbKM0Hf]{Spin & Shoot}

Gain two of the following Yellow abilities, using two different qualities:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.mi1P6JukisPzptzZ]{Called Shot}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.ApS6H8WML4YPpBJq]{Exploding Ammo}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.001KS0j5H863Xd47]{Hair Trigger Reflexes}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.CcgG4Q1nAIYsp6hv]{Ricochet}
Principle

Choose a Responsibility principle.

Personality

Roll d10, d10 for personality selection.
